desc: Shooters Choice FP-10 Lubricant Elite CLP Wipes offer their most popular formula – now in convenient-to-use wipes. The FP-10 Lubricant Elite CLP wipes clean lubricate and protect. With a wide temperature range of -49F – 500F, FP-10 reduces friction and wear, protects against rust & corrosion, and removes carbon, lead & powder fouling.
